projectTitle: AiAkiv — Shared Memory for AI Agents
description: AiAkiv (MemoryWeft) is hosted long-term memory that AI agents and teammates share over MCP. It stores conversations as a knowledge graph and recalls them across sessions, folders, and AI clients.
rules: The MCP endpoint is https://mcp.aiakiv.com/mcp. The URL MUST end with /mcp; the bare host (mcp.aiakiv.com) connects but exposes ZERO tools. Never guess a brand-domain URL like aiakiv.com/mcp.

AiAkiv is a HOSTED service (operated by OnMinimum), not an anonymous/public server. Connecting requires signing in via OAuth, or a project-bound API key (Gemini CLI). There is no keyless anonymous mode.
In ChatGPT and Codex, AiAkiv is listed in the plugin directory as AiAkiv Memory. Elsewhere it is not in a connector directory: add it manually as a custom connector with the endpoint above.

Memory is addressed as Team -> Project -> Domain. A Project is a named save-target; it can carry a PERSONA (a role the connected AI adopts). Project names are English-only (they ride in an HTTP header).

Folder clients (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI) pick a project with the X-K2G-Project header: create project, then connect. Global web clients (Claude Web, ChatGPT, Grok) follow the Main project: create project, set Main, connect.

Antigravity: its app-wide mcp_config.json supports headers, so a project API key in Authorization pins the project. The remote key MUST be `serverUrl` (`url`, `httpUrl`, `type` are rejected). Open: Agent panel > MCP Servers > Manage > View raw config.
Saving is explicit: only on an 'ak' command (e.g. 'ak save'). Never save on a bare 'remember' / 'save'. To recall, call search_memory(query) with the user's actual question as a full sentence.

Projects, teams, keys, Main-switching, and personas are managed by the human in the console at https://aiakiv.com. An AI can change them only through the console app, after the user turns the matching AI permission on.
